title: Essex, VT — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Essex, VT: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Essex is a city in VT with a population of 20,000. Chittenden County town with the Champlain Valley Expo and family-friendly communities. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
